# Global Apex SAS is a professional change management and business transformation
# consulting firm with offices in Guyancourt, France and Melbourne, Australia.

## About
Global Apex helps large enterprises navigate complex organizational change,
post-merger integration, digital transformation, and build sustainable internal
change management capability.

## Services
- Change Strategy: Organizational assessments, transformation roadmaps, stakeholder alignment
- Change Delivery: Embedded practitioners, adoption programs, communications, training
- Capability Building: Custom training, change management methodology, playbooks, CoE design
- Change Accelerators: Rapid-deployment programs for sponsorship activation, champion networks, health checks
